WEEK OF 10/26 - 11/01   (Phase 2 closed 10/27; Phase 3 Sprint 2 opened 10/27)

Outcomes so far
- Phase 2 closed on schedule on 10/27 with the HARA report (MPLr/PLr assignments) and STPA Step 2
  in draft and handed into Phase 3 for completion.
- The Platform Safety Plan is now a controlled, structured plan: 48 deliverables across the ten
  safety lifecycle phases, each with its work-product location, QMS references, author, verifier,
  reviewers, deadline and status, and a Safety Plan document generated from it on demand.
- The platform Activity Flow and the STPA Step 1 outputs (losses, hazards, constraints) are in
  draft and under peer review.
- Full, live visibility of the Wheel Loader Jira backlog for FSE: every ticket I am assigned,
  reported or watching is tracked with its status (Jira issues below). Eight are open today,
  six of them under the MVP3 / PDP Phase 3 Closeout epic.
- Onboarding checklist closed except one item: daily stand-up integrated, mentor meeting with
  Darsh Patel held, FSE introductions with Adolfo held, Jira board access in place, working-hour
  availability and check-in cadence established. Waiting on Rod DeMay's availability for the
  introduction meeting; invitation sent.

  Status questions (answered 10/28)
  - Where does FSE on Wheel Loader stand at the moment; any criticalities?
    Entering Phase 3 with a heavy backlog carried over from Phase 2 (STPA Step 2, HARA report,
    Preliminary Hazard List approval, Safety Plan dates).
  - What is the main challenge for FSE on Wheel Loader?
    Main challenge: clearing the Phase 2 backlog. Secondary challenge: establishing the dates
    for the whole programme so that functional safety can be decoupled from the programme
    timing and kept out of L0 and L1.

WEEK OF 10/12 - 10/18

Outcomes
- Onboarding sessions 10/12 to 10/14 completed: Wheel Loader programme, product development
  process (PDP phases), safety mechanisms and administrative controls (layered stopping, E-stop,
  all-stop, geofence, proximity monitor, heartbeat), verification and validation approach, Jira
  and QMS working practices.
- Working-knowledge base started from the sessions: tasks, facts, machine functions, use cases,
  QMS documents and people, so nothing said in onboarding is lost to the plan.
- Gaps identified for the Phase 1 document set (ConOps / Use Case specification, TOD/PRD,
  architecture documents) and raised for clarification.
- Access requested to the Wheel Loader Jira board and the FSE backlog.
